galleryReshoot.note: Every matched contourSlice cell (pathCount, totalPoints, inkMm) is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the W-34 baseline at sliceEndOverlap's default (0). This is the expected, required result — it proves the no-op default at the FULL APP/gallery pipeline level, not only in the unit test harness.

bespokeSweep.note: sphere/ellipsoid ink and open-run count rise roughly monotonically with k (extension working as designed, no self-occlusion to re-clip it away). torus ink is NOT monotone (1098.6 -> 1053.3 -> 1096.2 at k 0/4/8) and open-run count falls slightly (106 -> 104 -> 103) as k grows -- this is the plan's OWN documented, disclosed limitation (W-35-plan.md 4.1): at large k on a strongly self-occluding body, the extension is re-clipped by the shared HLR clipper and whole runs can be dropped or merged. It is not a regression; the clipper is the safety valve that prevents drawing through real occlusion. Confirmed the T2/T3 oracle deliberately does NOT assert monotone total ink for this reason (see the plan's own 3 note) -- the unit test's monotonicity proof instead uses a controlled synthetic ring via Scene3D.Slices.extendFrontChains directly, isolating the mechanism from crowd-cull/clip confounds.
